crossRefs.note: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
For the moth will eat them up like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool; but my righteousness will be…
But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
For we, through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.

translations.web: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”
translations.bsb: As it is written: “He has scattered abroad His gifts to the poor; His righteousness endures forever.”
translations.kjv: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.
translations.asv: as it is written, He hath scattered abroad, he hath given to the poor; His righteousness abideth for ever.
